# SureCost Blog

> > Insights on pharmacy purchasing optimization, DSCSA compliance, and profitability strategies for independent and health system pharmacies.

SureCost Blog provides data-driven guidance on pharmacy operations, featuring expertise from industry leaders like Danielle Dinglasan, Chad O'Connor, and Calvin Hunsicker. Content focuses on smarter purchasing strategies, regulatory compliance (DSCSA, 340B, DIR fees), and automation solutions to help pharmacies maximize profitability while maintaining patient care quality.

## Key Topics

- SureCost Smarter Purchasing Platform
- DSCSA Compliance (Drug Supply Chain Security Act)
- Pharmacy Purchasing Optimization
- 340B Program Management
- GPO Contract Optimization
- Primary Vendor Compliance
- Pharmacy Inventory Management
- DIR Fee Changes
- Drug Shortage Management
- Health System Pharmacy Procurement
- Purchasing Automation
- Pharmacy Profitability Strategies
- Invoice Accuracy & Vendor Management
- Pharmacy Buying Groups
- Patient Care Cost Savings

## Purchasing Optimization & Cost Savings

- [Unraveling the Secrets of Smarter Pharmacy Purchasing](https://blog.surecost.com/unraveling-the-secrets-of-smarter-pharmacy-purchasing): 2023 Annual Smarter Purchasing Report data-backed purchasing strategies
- [3 Manual Purchasing Processes Costing You Money](https://blog.surecost.com/best-in-class-purchasing-automation): White paper preview on automating manual purchasing processes for savings
- [7 Strategies to Ensure You Have a Profitable Pharmacy](https://blog.surecost.com/7-strategies-to-ensure-you-have-a-profitable-pharmacy): Seven strategies for pharmacy profitability through operations optimization
- [Simplified Purchasing: Pharmacy Staffing Shortage Solution](https://blog.surecost.com/simplified-purchasing-a-solution-for-pharmacy-staffing-shortages): Purchasing optimization to address NCPA-reported staffing shortages
- [Boost Profitability With Robust Pharmacy Inventory Management](https://blog.surecost.com/how-a-robust-pharmacy-inventory-management-system-can-boost-profitability): Effective pharmacy inventory management systems for profitability gains
- [How Smith Pharmacy Prescription Drug Savings Helps Patients](https://blog.surecost.com/smith-pharmacy-savings-benefit-patients): Smith Pharmacy case study on smarter purchasing for patient savings
